November 1, 2026


## With over 40 years of industry experience as a full-service lightering provider, our capability to resolve challenges and deliver unwavering reliability shines when it matters most.


When Placentia Bay required support to move cargo from Newfoundland’s offshore oil fields, Teekay stepped in with a seamless, agile response.


Partnering closely with the Basin Wide Transportation and Transshipment System (BWTTS), Teekay maintained continuous, safe, and efficient ship-to-ship (STS) operations to ensure zero disruption to offshore energy transportation.


Navigating complex regional regulations and severe weather conditions, our shore-based teams and offshore crews acted swiftly to keep Newfoundland crude moving.
